relations.subject: Earl of Ellesmere
relations.evidence: He also held the office of Chairman of the Oriental Translation Committee from the year 1852.

relations.subject: Thomas Ellis
relations.role: cataloguing the Syriac MSS. in the Library
relations.evidence: In the year 1851, Mr. Ellis received an appointment at the British Museum, where he remained until his death, chiefly occupied in cataloguing the Syriac MSS. in the Library.

relations.subject: Thomas Ellis
relations.role: decipherment and translation of Chaldee inscriptions
relations.evidence: Fac-similes of these inscriptions, with Mr. Ellis's trans- lations, were printed by Mr. Layard in his "Nineveh and Babylon."

relations.subject: Joseph von Hammer
relations.evidence: Soon after his return he projected the publication of a work on Eastern literature and sciences, which resulted in the valuable "Fundgruben des Orients," better known by its French title, "Mines de l'Orient,"
